pages.text: The morning sun shone. Fresh green grass grew beside the path. Today Nils would go to the lake with Grandpa.
Nils wanted to skip stones, a game where flat stones bounce on water. "I know the way! Follow me!"
He slipped onto a side path. "This is faster!" Grandpa followed.
Thorn bushes blocked the way. Thorns stuck in Nils's fur.
Then a fallen tree blocked the path. Nils struggled over it.
A roof showed between trees. Huh? Their cabin!
Nils had gone in a circle. The sun was high, but the lake was still far. His face reddened.
Grandpa asked, "Have you taken this side path before?" Nils shook his head.
Grandpa led along a path packed smooth by footsteps. Nils followed.
The lake! Nils threw a flat stone. Hop, hop, hop! Three circles appeared on the water.
